build_retention_releases.description: Keep BUILDS newer than the Nth-most-recent release, ordered by time rather than semver precedence (a backport released today must not move the boundary back to its version's position). 2 = pending builds plus one release of rollback window. Cannot exceed keep_semver_count, and with fewer than N releases there is no boundary and nothing is deleted.

cleanup_latest_tag.description: Delete a STRANDED `:latest` tag (DEFAULT true). A moving `:latest` left in a repository that has since been locked is otherwise permanent: the tag pins its digest alive, `keep_tags` shields it from the sweep, and an immutable repository refuses to move or remove it, so nothing ever converges. This removes the TAG REFERENCE only — the digest stays and is judged on its own merits by the NEXT sweep. Dropping `latest` from `keep_tags` instead is NOT equivalent: under build-once/promote a released digest carries both a sha tag and vX.Y.Z, so deleting the digest would take a release with it. Defaulting to true is safe because it only acts where `:latest` CANNOT be a live tag — under `enforce` (a moving tag is unpushable), or under `preserve` on an already-locked repository. Under `unlock`, or `preserve` on an unlocked repository, `:latest` may be a live updating tag and is left alone. Set false to opt out entirely. Unlike the sweep, this FAILS rather than degrades when the repository is locked and the service account cannot unlock it.

dry_run.description: true = print the plan only, delete nothing.

gcp_project.description: GCP project id owning the Artifact Registry repo.

gcp_region.description: Region of both the Artifact Registry repo and the Cloud Run Services/Jobs.

grace_period_days.description: Reprieve for artifacts outside the keep-set: one is deleted only once it is more than this many days OLDER than the oldest release-policy-retained image. 0 deletes them on the next sweep. Measured against your artifacts, not the wall clock, so the plan does not drift between runs.

immutable_tags_policy.description: What state the repository is left in after an applied sweep. `enforce` (DEFAULT) — the repository ends LOCKED whether or not it started that way; the sweep is the thing that makes immutable tags true everywhere. `preserve` — relock only if it was already locked (the pre-v2.1.0 behaviour); use this for a repository whose build still pushes a moving tag such as :latest, which an immutable repository rejects. `unlock` — leave it unlocked, warning loudly.

keep_semver_count.description: Per image, keep this many of the most recent RELEASES. Minimum 2 — the boundary that protects your builds is itself a release, so a policy that keeps fewer than two cannot express one.

keep_tag_prefixes.description: Comma-separated tag prefixes that are never deleted.

keep_tags.description: Comma-separated exact tags that are never deleted.

release_tag_pattern.description: Regex (Python re.match) identifying a production release tag. An artifact carrying one is a RELEASE; everything else is a BUILD. Getting this wrong is safe: no matches means no boundary, so nothing is ever deleted and the run warns that retention is inert.

relock_immutable_tags.description: DEPRECATED — use `immutable_tags_policy`. Kept so existing callers do not break: setting it false still means "leave the repository unlocked" and is folded into `immutable_tags_policy: unlock`. Its default (true) no longer means anything on its own.

build_only.description: Build and push the image, then stop — no Cloud Run mutation, no GitHub Deployment record. Use on `main` to publish image:<commit-sha> for a later promote-image run to retag. Mirrors promote-image.yml's `deploy_target: none`.

enforce_forward_only.description: Reject a deploy whose commit is BEHIND this environment's current live commit (an out-of-order / older deploy). registry_credentials.description: GCP SA-key JSON used to authenticate the server-side retag (`gcloud container images add-tag`). Required when `wif_provider` is empty (key-based auth); ignored on the WIF path.

dry_run.description: true = print the plan only, delete nothing.

gcp_project.description: GCP project id owning the Artifact Registry repo.

gcp_region.description: Region of the AR repo and the Cloud Run Services/Jobs.

packages.description: Comma/space-separated package names to retire (delete entirely).

outputs.retired: Number of packages actually deleted (0 on a dry run).

app_version.description: When set (kubectl/deployment), `kubectl set env APP_VERSION=…` after the roll.

cluster_project.description: GCP project owning the GKE cluster.

commit_sha.description: Source commit the rolled-to image was built from. Stamped onto the service (Cloud Run label / GKE annotation) and recorded as the env's live commit so forward-only stays accurate after the rollback. Strongly recommended; empty ⇒ stamping/deployment-record are skipped.

deploy_target.description: gke | cloud-run — what to roll. (No "none": a rollback must roll something.)

dry_run.description: Print the roll commands without executing them.

environment.description: Environment name for the GitHub Deployment record (e.g. production, staging).

gar_project.description: GCP project owning the Artifact Registry repo.

gcp_region.description: Region of the Artifact Registry host (…-docker.pkg.dev). Used to derive the host when image_registry is empty, and as the Cloud Run region default.

helm_release.description: Helm release name. Defaults to svc_name.

helm_values_path.description: Path to a Helm values file.

image_name.description: Image name within the GAR repo (may contain slashes, e.g. staging/api).

image_registry.description: Full Artifact Registry host (e.g. us-central1-docker.pkg.dev). Empty ⇒ derived as `<gcp_region>-docker.pkg.dev`.

reason.description: Free-text incident reference, recorded in the run summary and the GitHub Deployment.

record_github_deployment.description: Record a GitHub Deployment (+ success status) marking this environment's live commit = commit_sha. Requires `deployments: write` on the caller and a non-empty commit_sha.

rollback_digest.description: Existing digest to roll back TO (sha256:…). Immutable — the safest rollback target. Provide exactly one of rollback_tag / rollback_digest.

rollback_tag.description: Existing tag to roll the service back TO (e.g. a prior vX.Y.Z). Provide exactly one of rollback_tag / rollback_digest.

run_project.description: GCP project owning the Cloud Run service. Defaults to gar_project.

run_region.description: Cloud Run region. Defaults to gcp_region.

service_account.description: Service account email to impersonate via WIF (WIF path only).

svc_name.description: Workload AND container name (kubectl set image sets svc=image).

wif_provider.description: Workload Identity Federation provider resource name. Empty ⇒ KEY-BASED auth: image verification uses `registry_credentials`, the roll uses `cluster_credentials`.

outputs.image: Fully-qualified image the service was rolled back onto.

cluster_credentials.description: GCP SA-key JSON used to authenticate the roll (GKE/Cloud Run). Required when `wif_provider` is empty; ignored on the WIF path. May equal `registry_credentials`.

registry_credentials.description: GCP SA-key JSON used to verify the rollback image exists (`gcloud container images describe`). Required when `wif_provider` is empty; ignored on the WIF path.

expiry_warn_days.description: Emit a warning when the token expires within this many days.

scopes_md.description: Markdown bullet lines describing the custom-token scopes to create.

secret_targets.description: Space-separated "org/repo" list whose CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN secret must be updated.

zone_name.description: DNS zone the token is scoped to, used in the runbook text.

outputs.expires_on: Token expiry timestamp, empty when the token never expires.

cloudflare_api_token.description: The Cloudflare API token to verify.

bootstrap.description: true = tolerate missing bundle / missing services (first-run setup); no disable of an old version.

bundle_secret.description: Secret Manager bundle secret name (dotenv blob mounted into Cloud Run).

dry_run.description: true = print the plan; generate nothing, write nothing, roll nothing.

gcp_project.description: GCP project id holding the bundle secret and the Cloud Run services.

gcp_region.description: Region of the Cloud Run services.

key_id_name.description: Bundle key for the key id (kid = first 16 hex of SHA-256 over the public PEM).

mount_path.description: Container path the bundle is mounted at.

private_key_name.description: Bundle key for the base64-encoded private key PEM.

public_key_name.description: Bundle key for the base64-encoded public key PEM.

service_account.description: Service account email to impersonate via WIF.

services_csv.description: Comma-separated Cloud Run service names to roll onto the new version.

title.description: Human label for the run summary.

wif_provider.description: Workload Identity Federation provider resource name.

cf_worker_script.description: Cloudflare Worker script name that verifies the signature.

secret_bytes.description: Byte length of the generated secret (hex-encoded, so the string is 2x this).

args.description: Container args as gcloud''s comma-delimited list (e.g. `migrate`). Empty ⇒ --args is omitted and the image entrypoint decides.

dry_run.description: Print the gcloud commands without executing them.

env_vars.description: Passed verbatim to --set-env-vars. For values containing commas use gcloud''s custom-delimiter form: ^|^KEY=a,b|OTHER=c

runtime_service_account.description: Service account the TASK runs as — distinct from `service_account`, which is the deployer. Empty ⇒ the project default compute SA.
